IL: abstract and conclusion give 5.7 dB (at -7 V); p.3 says 6.3 dB 'on-chip IL = 14.6 dB' for the same device (14.6 dB matches the 9.3 um point of the cutback fit y = -0.64x - 8.51, Fig. 3(b), so it likely includes fiber facets and passive waveguide); 5.7 dB entered. Facet coupling 3.5 dB per facet; junction loss 0.6 dB measured (simulation 2.2 dB per junction); passive Si3N4 TM waveguide loss 1.29 dB/cm. Static ER 1.5 dB at +/-12 V and 0.85 dB at +/-7 V (Fig. 3(c)); 3D simulation gives 3.7 and 1.9 dB. Final ITO carrier concentration 3.0e20 cm-3 (1.9e20 after lift-off). Capacitance 400 fF measured (162 fF calculated), resistance 1140 Ohm measured (717 Ohm calculated); simulated electrical 3 dB bandwidth 1.36 GHz. Measured S21 fit: 3 dB at 1.05 GHz and 6 dB at 2.3 GHz (Fig. 4(d), normalized S21, reference level not stated). One-port and two-port RF electrodes fabricated; the one-port version is shown. Optimized-geometry bandwidth beyond 260 GHz is an expectation citing Ref. [7], not entered. Wavelength 1550 nm, TM polarization. Metal stack Ti/Al, thicknesses not stated.
